## What you did
- You prepared the prod PG15→PG17 cutover as an RDS blue/green deployment: Terraform on prod (plan clean, 0 destroys), and a runbook in `runbooks/pg17-cutover.md` [1].
- You rehearsed the full cutover on a snapshot clone: 74 s of write downtime, lag under 1 s, no data mismatch — then tore the clone down [1].
- You pushed back on treating rollback as "switching back" (the old blue diverges immediately after switchover), and Maya approved the resulting PR #321 with a good-catch note on the replica [1][3].

## What changed
- **The cutover window has moved to Sunday 22/11, 02:00–04:00 UTC** — Fernhill's month-end batch runs Saturday night until ~06:00 UTC. Maya has told the CSMs and says you can update the runbook and merge #321 [8].
- Daniel Levi will be on call for the API side on Sunday and asks to be pinged when you start the switchover [7].
- Lior's ingest workers need no changes (DATABASE_URL from SSM), but he wants 30 min notice before the switchover to pause the consumers cleanly [9].
- AWS provider 5.80 → 5.82 is up for review via Renovate (#320), automerge disabled [4].

## What is still open
- **Rollback rehearsal on a fresh clone, Thursday 19/11** — it's in the runbook as a TODO before the window; you need to measure duration and data loss, since rollback is not a simple switch back [1].
- Update the runbook to the Sunday window and merge #321 [8][3].
